sources: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/sites/g/files/lrnvjt1351/files/Harvest-Park-2026-Campground-Availability-10-16-26_0.pdf (county campground map / information board, as of 10/16/2026)

values.note: 57 full-hookup sites (the county gives no site lengths). Two vehicles per site, parked in front of the camper.

sites.source: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground ('57 total sites, all with full hookups') + county campground map PDF (sites 1-57; 'TWO (2) VEHICLES PER SITE'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground ('all with full hookups'; 'Harvest Park has 30 and 50 amp ... at Sites #1-12. Remaining sites have 50 amp') + county map PDF ('RENTAL RATES (includes electric, water, & sewer)'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Public restrooms and showers are in the Phillips County Event Center (north side, doors facing the racetrack).

facilities.source: county campground map PDF ('PUBLIC RESTROOMS/SHOWERS: On the North Side of the Event Center. The doors face the racetrack'), read 2026-10-28; the county's page and board mention no dump station or Wi-Fi (the board lists only an 'INTERNET SERVICE' phone number), so the note-derived dump and Wi-Fi values are cleared

values.note: Water at sites 1-25 is shut off October 1 - March 1 (sites 26-57 keep water); winter campers need heat tape on their water line.

season.source: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground ('Open year-round, however the water will be shut off on Sites #1 - 25 on October 1 through March 1') + winter insulation policy PDF ('All campers are REQUIRED to have heat tape on water lines'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First come, first served with self check-in: fill in an envelope at the information board and drop payment in the box (cash or check; cards weekdays 8-4:30 at the Event Center office, the courthouse, or by phone). Only the whole campground can be reserved, through the County Administration Office. Stays over 2 months need a long-term lease ($650 deposit); over 6 months, review by the county commissioners.

booking.source: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground ('Space is available on a first come, first served basis. Self check-in (forms at information board). To reserve the entire campground, please call the County Administration Office') + county map PDF ('STAYS LONGER THAN 2 MONTHS REQUIRE A LONG-TERM LEASE AGREEMENT'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $35 the first night, $30 each night after; $200 a week, $650 for 4 weeks. Includes electric, water and sewer. Dry/tent camping $15. No refunds.

fees.source: https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground ('$35 first day, $30/day thereafter, OR $200 for 1 week (7 days) OR $650 for 4 Weeks (28 days)') + county map PDF as of 10/16/2026 ('Dry/Tent camping: $15/night'; 'NO REFUNDS'), read 2026-10-28

note: Phillips County RV campground at Harvest Park (the county fairgrounds), 1/2 mile north of the US 6 / US 385 stoplight in Holyoke. May fill during the fair and other events. --Claude
summary: County page + campground map PDF: confirmed 57 full-hookup sites (50 amp; 30/50 at sites 1-12), showers, $35 first night / $30 after, phone 970-854-3778. Added year-round season (water off at sites 1-25 Oct-Mar), first-come self check-in booking. Cleared note-derived dump and Wi-Fi (county pages don't state them). Website should be the campground's own county page. Note trimmed.
flags: Website is the county home page; the campground's own page is https://phillipscounty.colorado.gov/harvest-park-rv-campground.
Phone 970-854-3778 confirmed (County Administration Office, campground page). Maintenance line for problems: 970-466-0482 (campground map).
No site lengths published; no fair-week closure is mentioned on the page or the board.

Long-stay character (informational; local government, so the private long-stay tests do not apply): the county's availability map as of 10/16/2026 shows 29 of 57 sites occupied (all of 1-25 plus 29, 35, 38, 45); stays over 2 months need a lease and a $650 deposit. Nightly first-come camping is clearly offered with a posted rate.
